document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You find a letter find a letter from a Mr. Velikovsky, postmarked 
Palestine. The scrawl is difficult to read, but you can see that 
the author greets Gliere’s work “with joy.” There is a page about 
the Vedas and how they confirm something called the “Polar 
Reversal.” One portion deals with the “Era of Fertility on the 
Frozen Continent.” Velikovsky reports that work on “Freudian 
Heroes”—including Ikhenaten—continues. Go to 150.
(32)
